identity.referencePolicy: All scene/npc/event/fact/item/flag/thread/ending references resolve in current world only. A qualified ref with a different worldId is rejected. No lookup fallback to any other world.

storage.collisionPolicy: Identical localIds in different worlds are valid and isolate fully.
storage.readPolicy: Every lookup requires session's pinned worldId and canonicalRevision; no global latest lookup.
storage.publication: Approved immutable manifest binds all required content revisions; publish creates new revision, never mutates old.

revisionPolicy.initial: Pin a complete world manifest revision on session start.
revisionPolicy.activeSession: Read pinned manifest and its pinned object revisions for full duration, even if a new world revision publishes.
revisionPolicy.upgrade: Only an explicit admin/user-authorized migration with compatibility validation, stable session state mapping and rollback; default never auto-upgrade.
revisionPolicy.legacy: Ambiguous legacy runs fail closed; never infer from latest or choose first world.
revisionPolicy.endingSnapshot: Record pinned worldId, manifest revision, and explicit commit provenance.

transfer.exception: Versioned explicit transfer manifest listing authorized player-visible fields, destination world, mapping, compatibility, consent; never copy secret NPC knowledge or canonical plot facts automatically.

authoring.references: All object refs are qualified with worldId:localId; use localId only as a storage field.
authoring.secretStorage: private D1 / protected private authoring store only, never GitHub/shared mailbox
authoring.knowledge: Course concepts and application tags are shared library references; never transfer hidden world facts through educational retrieval.
